items.en: Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with \$0.20/Mtok cache reads
items.zh: 新增 Claude Fable 5.2（`claude-fable-5-2`），现为默认 Fable 模型——1M 上下文，每 Mtok $8/$40，缓存读取每 Mtok \$0.20

items.en: Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
items.zh: 为 `claude remote-control` 新增 `--settings <file>`，将设置文件应用到它启动的每个 session；如果文件发生变化，在你重启 `claude remote-control` 之前不会启动新的 session

items.en: \[VSCode] Added a warning above the prompt box when both an auth token and an API key are set, matching the terminal's startup warning
items.zh: \[VSCode] 当同时设置了认证 token 和 API key 时，在 prompt 框上方新增警告，与终端的启动警告一致

items.en: Updated the session-feedback message and the `allowedProviders` setting description to name Ultra alongside Pro and Max, and the `forceLoginMethod` description to cover every paid Claude plan
items.zh: 更新 session 反馈消息和 `allowedProviders` 设置说明，在 Pro 和 Max 之外一并列出 Ultra；`forceLoginMethod` 说明改为覆盖所有付费 Claude 方案

items.en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill to suggest a list of meters, one row per item, for several ratios that each have their own limit
items.zh: 更新内置 dataviz skill，对于多个各自有独立上限的比率，建议使用仪表列表，每项一行

items.en: Updated the "Upgrade to Max" options to say "Upgrade to Max or Ultra"
items.zh: 更新“Upgrade to Max”选项，改为“Upgrade to Max or Ultra”

items.en: Changed mods Claude writes to turn on without asking in auto and bypass modes, even with managed `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` or `allowManagedDomainsOnly`, and not to load in `dontAsk` mode
items.zh: 变更 Claude 写入的 mod：在自动模式和 bypass 模式下无需询问即可启用，即使设置了托管的 `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` 或 `allowManagedDomainsOnly`；在 `dontAsk` 模式下不加载

items.en: Changed mods' own tool calls (`$.tool.call`, `$.mcp.call`) to raise no permission prompt, even under your own ask rules or in `dontAsk` and `-p` runs; deny rules and organization policy still apply
items.zh: 变更 mod 自身的工具调用（`$.tool.call`、`$.mcp.call`）：不再触发权限提示，即使在你自己的 ask 规则下、在 `dontAsk` 和 `-p` 运行中也是如此；deny 规则和组织策略仍然生效

items.en: Changed saved Fable 5.1 model picks to move to `fable`: on Pro and Max plans at once, on Team and Enterprise plans once your organization allows it; use `/model claude-fable-5-1` to switch back
items.zh: 变更已保存的 Fable 5.1 模型选择，改为迁移到 `fable`：Pro 和 Max 方案立即生效，Team 和 Enterprise 方案在组织允许后生效；使用 `/model claude-fable-5-1` 可切回

items.en: Changed the fast mode labels in `/fast`, `/config` and `/model` to name your current model when it supports fast mode, and removed "(Opus only)" from the VS Code row
items.zh: 变更 `/fast`、`/config` 和 `/model` 中的快速模式标签：当前模型支持快速模式时显示其名称，并从 VS Code 行中移除“(Opus only)”

items.en: Changed nested skill loading: `.claude/skills` folders inside `~/.claude/plugins` no longer load when Claude works on files there
items.zh: 变更嵌套 skill 加载：Claude 处理 `~/.claude/plugins` 内的文件时，不再加载其中的 `.claude/skills` 文件夹

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed an on-demand runner that the server refuses because it is not needed (session ended or paused, work order superseded) to exit 0 instead of 1
items.zh: 自托管运行器：变更按需运行器在服务器因其不需要而拒绝时（session 已结束或暂停、工单已被取代）以退出码 0 而非 1 退出

items.en: Windows: Changed how Claude Code finds programs it starts itself, such as git, to skip relative and UNC PATH entries and links onto a network share, and to pick up PATH changes from settings
items.zh: Windows：变更 Claude Code 查找其自行启动的程序（如 git）的方式，跳过相对路径和 UNC PATH 条目以及指向网络共享的链接，并从设置中获取 PATH 变更

items.en: Changed OpenTelemetry hook events in non-interactive sessions to leave two built-in hooks out of `num_hooks` and `num_success` after Bash and PowerShell calls
items.zh: 变更非交互式 session 中的 OpenTelemetry hook 事件：在 Bash 和 PowerShell 调用后，将两个内置 hook 排除在 `num_hooks` 和 `num_success` 之外

items.en: Changed the number of messages a Claude Desktop Code tab session can send to your other sessions before it waits for you to type again from 10 to 20
items.zh: 变更 Claude Desktop Code 标签页 session 在等待你再次输入之前可向其他 session 发送的消息数，从 10 改为 20

items.en: Changed `AskUserQuestion` in `claude -p` and SDK sessions to deny a host's permission answer that sets the undocumented `afkTimeoutMs` input field
items.zh: 变更 `claude -p` 和 SDK session 中的 `AskUserQuestion`：拒绝宿主设置未文档化的 `afkTimeoutMs` 输入字段的权限答复

items.en: Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces`: a declared name can't be added from another source, an entry from elsewhere is hidden, and plugins the declared marketplace lists are reinstalled from it
items.zh: 变更托管的 `extraKnownMarketplaces`：已声明的名称不能从其他来源添加，来自其他位置的条目会被隐藏，已声明 marketplace 列出的 plugin 会从该 marketplace 重新安装

items.en: Changed Claude in Chrome tools that an app running Claude Code provides, such as the Claude desktop app's Code tab, to follow your organization's Claude in Chrome policy
items.zh: 变更运行 Claude Code 的应用（如 Claude 桌面应用的 Code 标签页）提供的 Claude in Chrome 工具，使其遵循你组织的 Claude in Chrome 策略

items.en: Changed `policy_mode: layered` in the Claude apps gateway: managed MCP servers now add up over every matching policy, `match: {}` included, so a gateway already on it serves more after the upgrade
items.zh: 变更 Claude 应用网关中的 `policy_mode: layered`：托管的 MCP 服务器现在会在所有匹配的策略上累加，包括 `match: {}`，因此已启用该模式的网关在升级后会提供更多内容

items.en: Gateway: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry upstreams to ignore the `ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` variables in the gateway's environment. Set `base_url` on the upstream to use another endpoint
items.zh: 网关：变更 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 上游，忽略网关环境中的 `ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` 变量。要使用其他端点，请在上游设置 `base_url`

items.en: Changed headless sessions to reload mods in `.claude/skills` when their files change; set `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0` to turn this off
items.zh: 变更无头 session：当 `.claude/skills` 中的 mod 文件发生变化时重新加载；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0` 可关闭此行为

items.en: Changed the Cyber Verification Program sentence on a cyber safeguard block to use the same words as claude.ai
items.zh: 变更网络安全防护拦截提示中的 Cyber Verification Program 语句，使其与 claude.ai 使用相同措辞

items.en: Changed Cowork cloud sessions: a PostToolUse hook can no longer replace the answer to AskUserQuestion or the plan in ExitPlanMode's result; Claude reads the originals
items.zh: 变更 Cowork 云 session：PostToolUse hook 不能再替换 AskUserQuestion 的答案或 ExitPlanMode 结果中的计划；Claude 读取原始内容

items.en: Changed `cp` and `mv` spelled by a path, such as `/bin/cp`, to get the same path checks as `cp` and `mv`
items.zh: 变更以路径形式书写的 `cp` 和 `mv`（如 `/bin/cp`），使其获得与 `cp` 和 `mv` 相同的路径检查

items.en: Changed background command notifications and TaskStop results to show Claude only the start and end of a command over 1,000 characters, which saves context
items.zh: 变更后台命令通知和 TaskStop 结果：对于超过 1,000 个字符的命令，只向 Claude 显示开头和结尾，以节省上下文

items.en: Changed artifact design guidance to treat Inter and Space Grotesk as good default typefaces
items.zh: 变更 artifact 设计指引，将 Inter 和 Space Grotesk 视为合适的默认字体

items.en: Changed the account email check to refuse only a shell command that holds your email and names a User-Agent, without asking, so other commands and scheduled runs no longer stop at its prompt
items.zh: 变更账户邮箱检查：仅对包含你的邮箱且声明了 User-Agent 的 shell 命令直接拒绝、不再询问，因此其他命令和定时运行不再停在其提示处

items.en: Changed Remote Control sessions to keep the folder they were started in: a connected client can no longer move a session to another folder
items.zh: 变更 Remote Control session：保持其启动时所在的文件夹；已连接的客户端不能再将会话移动到其他文件夹

items.en: Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` take-overs from an undeclared source: saved data is set aside for `cleanupPeriodDays`, and options and secrets until `claude plugin restore-set-aside`
items.zh: 变更受管 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 对未声明来源的接管：已保存的数据保留 `cleanupPeriodDays` 天，选项和密钥保留至执行 `claude plugin restore-set-aside`

items.en: Improved the `/model` picker: "More models" is now an unnumbered row below every other, and older models open under it without renumbering the rest
items.zh: 改进 `/model` 选择器：“More models”现在是不带编号的行，位于所有其他行之下，较旧的模型在其下展开，且不会重新编号其余项

items.en: Gateway: Improved spend limits on a busy replica, which now skips fewer checks and records spend sooner
items.zh: 网关：改进繁忙副本上的支出限制，现在会跳过更少的检查并更早记录支出

items.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's sign-in limit messages in Claude Code and on the `/device` page: they no longer name gateway settings, which the gateway's own log still names
items.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关在 Claude Code 和 `/device` 页面上的登录限制提示：不再提及网关设置，相关设置仍记录在网关自身日志中

items.en: Improved `claude install` and the install scripts: they finish 2 to 4 seconds sooner
items.zh: 改进 `claude install` 和安装脚本：完成时间提前 2 到 4 秒

items.en: Improved how soon a Remote Control session whose process crashed can pick up a new message
items.zh: 改进进程已崩溃的 Remote Control session 接收新消息的速度

items.en: Windows: Improved startup and first-command time by finding programs on PATH without starting a helper process
items.zh: Windows：改进启动和首条命令的耗时，查找 PATH 中的程序时不再启动辅助进程

items.en: Improved auto mode in headless sessions, the desktop app and VS Code: reports from background subagents that wait together are answered in one model call, as in the terminal
items.zh: 改进无头 session、桌面应用和 VS Code 中的自动模式：同时等待的后台 subagent 报告会在一次模型调用中一并回复，与终端中一致

items.en: Improved the agent view's row for a `claude --bg --worktree` session that couldn't set up its worktree: it now shows the error from its beginning, not an internal tag or its last 200 characters
items.zh: 改进 agent 视图中无法设置 worktree 的 `claude --bg --worktree` session 行：现在从开头显示错误，而不是内部标记或其最后 200 个字符

items.en: Improved the messages shown when an artifact is in another organization: `/login` is offered only if it's one of yours, and Claude now says where a copy may be after an account move
items.zh: 改进 artifact 位于其他组织时显示的消息：仅当该组织属于你时才提供 `/login`，且 Claude 现在会在账户迁移后说明副本可能所在的位置

items.en: Improved sessions with more images than fit in one request: Claude is told whether it has already seen a dropped image, and repeat reads of an unchanged image are limited
items.zh: 改进图片数量超出单次请求容量的 session：会告知 Claude 是否已看过被丢弃的图片，并限制对未变更图片的重复读取

items.en: Improved `claude remote-control`'s messages for an unanswered first-run question: each now says what to do next
items.zh: 改进 `claude remote-control` 对首次运行问题未获回答时的提示：每条现在都会说明下一步该做什么

items.en: Improved start-up time by loading trusted TLS certificates faster
items.zh: 通过加快受信任 TLS 证书的加载速度，改进了启动时间

items.en: Improved Claude apps gateway error messages to show the gateway's address without any user name or password
items.zh: 改进了 Claude 应用网关的错误消息，显示网关地址时不再包含任何用户名或密码

items.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend limit error: the reset now shows in your local time, such as "resets 4pm (America/Los\_Angeles)"
items.zh: 改进了 Claude 应用网关的支出限额错误：重置时间现在按本地时间显示，例如 "resets 4pm (America/Los\_Angeles)"

items.en: Windows: Improved startup time with a standard Git for Windows install by no longer checking which git.exe to run on every launch
items.zh: Windows：在标准 Git for Windows 安装下改进了启动时间，不再在每次启动时检查要运行哪个 git.exe

items.en: Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them
items.zh: 修复了当服务器重定向时，MCP OAuth 请求将刷新令牌等机密发送到另一主机的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt
items.zh: 修复了只读 Bash 命令在没有权限提示的情况下在沙箱外运行的问题

items.en: Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged a file write from the wrong folder and didn't prompt
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限检查从错误文件夹判断文件写入且未提示的问题

items.en: Fixed deny rules and protected-file prompts not applying to the file that a `cp` or `mv` into a directory writes
items.zh: 修复了拒绝规则和保护文件提示未应用于通过 `cp` 或 `mv` 写入目录时所写文件的问题

items.en: Fixed the "Draws from usage credits" note showing after a switch to Fable on Enterprise seats whose plan includes Fable
items.zh: 修复了在计划包含 Fable 的 Enterprise 席位切换到 Fable 后仍显示 "Draws from usage credits" 提示的问题

items.en: Fixed the fallback model sometimes declining a request or mentioning a stopped response when the first model was blocked before replying
items.zh: 修复了当第一个模型在回复前被阻止时，回退模型有时拒绝请求或提及已停止响应的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude mcp login` printing a SEP-2352 issuer warning each time you sign in again to a server that Claude Code registered with
items.zh: 修复了 `claude mcp login` 在每次重新登录 Claude Code 注册的服务器时打印 SEP-2352 签发者警告的问题

items.en: Fixed `NotebookEdit` deleting or overwriting a notebook's first cell when the call named no cell, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
items.zh: 修复了在网络路径（UNC 共享、WSL 文件夹、`/net` 挂载）上，当调用未指定单元格时 `NotebookEdit` 删除或覆盖 notebook 第一个单元格的问题

items.en: Fixed Edit changing the first of several matches, replacing a whole file on an empty `old_string`, or editing a notebook as text, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, `/net` mounts)
items.zh: 修复了在网络路径（UNC 共享、WSL 文件夹、`/net` 挂载）上，Edit 更改多个匹配项中的第一个、在 `old_string` 为空时替换整个文件或将 notebook 作为文本编辑的问题

items.en: Fixed `/config` showing Manual as the default permission mode when new sessions start in auto mode; pressing Space on "Auto (default)" now saves Don't Ask, not Plan
items.zh: 修复了当新 session 以自动模式启动时 `/config` 将 Manual 显示为默认权限模式的问题；现在在 "Auto (default)" 上按 Space 会保存 Don't Ask，而不是 Plan

items.en: Windows: Fixed `FileChanged` hooks stopping for paths set through `watchPaths` after the first shell command, when the session's working directory had a lowercase drive letter
items.zh: Windows：修复了当 session 的工作目录盘符为小写时，通过 `watchPaths` 设置的路径的 `FileChanged` hook 在第一个 shell 命令后停止的问题

items.en: Fixed `--plugin-dir .` and `--plugin-dir ./builtin` writing generated type files for Claude Code's built-in plugins into a `builtin` folder
items.zh: 修复了 `--plugin-dir .` 和 `--plugin-dir ./builtin` 将 Claude Code 内置 plugin 的生成类型文件写入 `builtin` 文件夹的问题

items.en: Fixed context usage estimates overcounting tool definitions when exact token counts are unavailable
items.zh: 修复了在无法获得精确 token 计数时，上下文用量估算高估工具定义的问题

items.en: Fixed `/compact` showing twice in Remote Control on web and mobile
items.zh: 修复了 `/compact` 在网页版和移动端的远程控制中显示两次的问题

items.en: Fixed plugin auto-updates and `/plugin` marketplace updates downloading a plugin again for each worktree or folder of a repository
items.zh: 修复了 plugin 自动更新和 `/plugin` marketplace 更新会为仓库的每个 worktree 或文件夹重复下载 plugin 的问题

items.en: Fixed auto mode losing a background subagent's report that had started a turn when the conversation was compacted before Claude answered it
items.zh: 修复了当对话在 Claude 回答前被上下文压缩时，自动模式丢失已开始一轮的后台 subagent 报告的问题

items.en: Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree
items.zh: 修复了项目 skill、命令和 agent 在其文件夹于 session 中途被删除后又恢复（例如通过 `git stash`）后仍显示缺失的问题，包括进入 worktree 之后

items.en: Fixed `claude -p` sometimes telling Claude that background commands get 30 minutes when they are stopped after 10
items.zh: 修复了 `claude -p` 有时告知 Claude 后台命令有 30 分钟时限，而实际在 10 分钟后即被停止的问题

items.en: Fixed `pkill`, `pgrep` and `pidwait` in cloud sessions matching the session's own parent processes
items.zh: 修复了云 session 中的 `pkill`、`pgrep` 和 `pidwait` 匹配到该 session 自身父进程的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome and computer use server processes staying alive after their parent exits behind a proxy that stalls connections
items.zh: 修复了 Claude in Chrome 和 computer use 的服务器进程在父进程退出后仍存活的问题，该场景发生在代理会挂起连接的后面

items.en: Fixed a large hook output pointing Claude to a file that held another hook's output from the same tool call
items.zh: 修复了大量 hook 输出指向的文件中存放的是同一次工具调用中另一个 hook 的输出这一问题

items.en: Fixed apps that embed Claude Code getting their own PreToolUse hook's `ask` reason instead of another hook's when both asked
items.zh: 修复了嵌入 Claude Code 的应用在自身 PreToolUse hook 与另一个 hook 都请求 `ask` 时，拿到的是另一个 hook 的 `ask` 原因而非自身原因的问题

items.en: Fixed a PreToolUse hook's `ask` being lost when another hook's `defer` finished first and could not be honored
items.zh: 修复了当另一个 hook 的 `defer` 先完成且无法被满足时，PreToolUse hook 的 `ask` 丢失的问题

items.en: Fixed a rare crash on permission prompts and background tasks
items.zh: 修复了权限提示和后台任务中偶发的崩溃

items.en: Fixed project skills, commands and agents disappearing from the menu in SDK and desktop sessions after Claude entered a worktree
items.zh: 修复了 SDK 和桌面应用 session 中，Claude 进入 worktree 后项目 skill、命令和 agent 从菜单中消失的问题

items.en: Fixed `/desktop` on macOS saying Claude Desktop is not installed when it is in `~/Applications`
items.zh: 修复了 macOS 上 `/desktop` 在 Claude Desktop 位于 `~/Applications` 时提示未安装的问题

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry repository attributes (`vcs.*`) missing from Claude Desktop sessions that start on a pre-started process
items.zh: 修复了在预启动进程上启动的 Claude Desktop session 中缺少 OpenTelemetry 仓库属性（`vcs.*`）的问题

items.en: Fixed WebFetch passing "No response from model" to Claude as page content when the model reading the page returned no text; the call now fails with a clear error
items.zh: 修复了 WebFetch 在读取页面的模型未返回文本时把“No response from model”作为页面内容传给 Claude 的问题；现在该调用会以明确的错误失败

items.en: Fixed screen reader mode delaying the prompt at startup when the system clock moved back while Claude Code was starting
items.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式下，Claude Code 启动期间系统时钟回拨导致启动时 prompt 延迟的问题

items.en: Fixed a command's panel sometimes not coming back after a dialog closed, leaving no panel or prompt on screen until the next redraw
items.zh: 修复了命令面板在对话框关闭后有时不恢复，导致屏幕上没有面板或 prompt 直到下次重绘的问题

items.en: Fixed a project's MCP server being disconnected after the first message in a Claude Desktop Code tab session when the desktop app has an MCP server or extension of the same name
items.zh: 修复了当桌面应用存在同名 MCP 服务器或扩展时，Claude Desktop Code 标签页 session 中项目 MCP 服务器在第一条消息后被断开的问题

items.en: Fixed a turn ending with "API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed" when the connection broke partway through a reply; the partial reply is kept or the request is retried, as before 2.1.302
items.zh: 修复了回复中途连接断开时，回合以“API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed”结束的问题；现在会保留部分回复或重试请求，与 2.1.302 之前的行为一致

items.en: Fixed high memory use in long sessions that repeatedly read single lines from large files
items.zh: 修复了长时间 session 中反复从大文件读取单行导致的高内存占用

items.en: Fixed fast mode losing replies, switching models or retrying for minutes when fast serving is rate-limited, overloaded or failing; it now tries standard speed on the same model first
items.zh: 修复了快速模式在快速服务被限流、过载或故障时丢失回复、切换模型或重试数分钟的问题；现在会先在同一模型上尝试标准速度

items.en: Fixed one request carrying far more background agent reports than intended after Claude was stopped while several were waiting
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 在多个后台 agent 报告等待期间被停止后，单个请求携带远超预期的后台 agent 报告的问题

items.en: Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop Code tab session to your other sessions staying paused after you typed while Claude was still working
items.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop Code 标签页 session 发往其他 session 的消息在 Claude 仍在工作时你输入内容后保持暂停的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude agents` ignoring `--permission-mode`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `--model`, `--effort` or `--agent` typed before `agents` when a flag such as `--verbose` was also on the line
items.zh: 修复了 `claude agents` 忽略在 `agents` 之前输入的 `--permission-mode`、`--dangerously-skip-permissions`、`--model`、`--effort` 或 `--agent` 的问题：当命令行中同时带有 `--verbose` 等标志时会出现该问题

items.en: Fixed a case where Remote Control showed as off with "login expired" in the desktop app while its connection was still up, because the app was briefly unable to hand over a sign-in token
items.zh: 修复了桌面应用中 Remote Control 显示为关闭并提示“login expired”、但连接实际仍然正常的情况，原因是应用短暂无法交付登录 token

items.en: Fixed a Remote Control message sent with "Queue for later" reaching Claude in the middle of the running turn
items.zh: 修复了通过“Queue for later”发送的 Remote Control 消息在运行中的回合中途送达 Claude 的问题

items.en: Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start reading as clean when git status failed; it now reads as unavailable
items.zh: 修复了 git status 失败时，session 启动时提供给 Claude 的 git 状态被读取为干净的问题；现在会读取为不可用

items.en: Fixed the git status given to Claude at session start showing the first listed file as staged when its changes were not staged
items.zh: 修复了 session 启动时提供给 Claude 的 git 状态将列出的第一个文件显示为已暂存、而其变更实际并未暂存的问题

items.en: Fixed a hang or out-of-memory crash when a connector in a cloud session lists resources with very long names
items.zh: 修复了云 session 中的 connector 列出名称极长的资源时出现卡死或内存耗尽崩溃的问题

items.en: Fixed Remote Control showing as connected after its connection closed for good while the session's history was still uploading
items.zh: 修复了 Remote Control 在连接彻底关闭、而 session 历史仍在上传时仍显示为已连接的问题

items.en: Fixed screen reader mode turning off when you return to a conversation from agent view
items.zh: 修复了从 agent 视图返回对话时屏幕阅读器模式被关闭的问题

items.en: Fixed screen reader mode y/n questions taking as yes a stray "y" at the end of text typed as the question opened
items.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式的 y/n 问题在问题弹出时输入的文本末尾带有零散“y”时被当作“是”的问题

items.en: Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that a host is probably not allowed when it is allowed and the network proxy could not connect to it
items.zh: 修复了云 session 在主机实际被允许、只是网络代理无法连接时告知 Claude 该主机可能不被允许的问题

items.en: Fixed an MCP server sometimes showing as connected with no tools after it was reconnected or the session's directory changed while its tools were still loading
items.zh: 修复了 MCP server 在重新连接后、或在其工具仍在加载时 session 目录发生变化后，有时显示为已连接但没有工具的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash commands sometimes running in the wrong folder when Claude sent several at once and an earlier one changed folders
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 同时发送多条 Bash 命令、且较早的一条切换了目录时，后续命令有时在错误文件夹中运行的问题

items.en: Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing at once when an upload gets an HTTP 507 from a proxy; the upload now gets a second try
items.zh: 修复了云 session 和 Remote Control session 中 Claude 发送的文件在上传收到代理返回的 HTTP 507 时立即失败的问题；现在上传会再重试一次

items.en: Fixed new messages not being saved, and `claude -p`, SDK and VS Code sessions hanging, when memory ran out while the transcript was being read
items.zh: 修复了读取 transcript 时内存耗尽导致新消息无法保存、以及 `claude -p`、SDK 和 VS Code session 卡死的问题

items.en: Fixed sign-in, token refresh and logout waiting indefinitely when something on the network accepts the connection but never answers the TLS handshake
items.zh: 修复了网络上某处接受连接但从不响应 TLS 握手时，登录、token 刷新和登出无限等待的问题

items.en: Fixed a sent file showing under a different name in the Claude apps when its name hid text-direction or control characters; Claude now refuses to send such a file
items.zh: 修复了已发送文件在名称隐藏文字方向或控制字符时，在 Claude 应用中显示为其他名称的问题；Claude 现在会拒绝发送此类文件

items.en: Fixed sub-agent progress summaries running a request to its end after the model replied with a tool call
items.zh: 修复了 sub-agent 进度摘要在模型以工具调用回复后仍将请求执行到底的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash reads such as `grep -r foo "$PWD/src"` asking for permission when the same command with the path typed out runs without asking
items.zh: 修复了 `grep -r foo "$PWD/src"` 等 Bash 读取操作需要请求权限、而将路径直接写出的同一命令无需询问即可运行的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude apps gateway refusing to start when a `desktop` setting holds a field newer than the gateway, such as a managed MCP server's `oauth.omitResource`; it now warns and serves it
items.zh: 修复了 `desktop` 设置包含比网关更新的字段（例如托管 MCP server 的 `oauth.omitResource`）时 Claude 应用网关拒绝启动的问题；现在会发出警告并继续提供服务

items.en: Fixed Bash commands coming back empty for zsh users whose `.zshrc` sets `KSH_OPTION_PRINT`
items.zh: 修复了 `.zshrc` 设置了 `KSH_OPTION_PRINT` 的 zsh 用户 Bash 命令返回为空的问题

items.en: macOS: Fixed "Unable to read managed policy settings" at startup when a valid MDM profile was slow to read: the read is retried once, and a timeout is now reported as a timeout
items.zh: macOS：修复启动时在有效的 MDM 配置文件读取较慢的情况下报出“Unable to read managed policy settings”的问题：现在会重试一次读取，超时也会按超时上报

items.en: Fixed agent view erasing another agent view's saved input text when it restarted for an update with nothing typed
items.zh: 修复 agent 视图因更新而重启且未输入任何内容时，会清除另一个 agent 视图已保存输入文本的问题

items.en: Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay
items.zh: 修复远程 session 在重启后无回复的问题：当 `UserPromptSubmit` hook 阻止了重放的权限应答时会出现该问题；这些 hook 不再在该重放中运行

items.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` accepting a `y` typed without Enter at its first-run question when the terminal's input ended
items.zh: 修复 `claude remote-control` 在首次运行提问时，若终端输入已结束，会接受未按 Enter 输入的 `y` 的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude Desktop not showing spend limit warnings behind a Claude apps gateway whose policy has no `code:` rules
items.zh: 修复 Claude Desktop 在 Claude 应用网关的策略中没有 `code:` 规则时，不显示支出限额警告的问题

items.en: Fixed fullscreen sessions with some plugins ending with an error when a tool result that had got shorter scrolled off the top of the screen
items.zh: 修复部分 plugin 的全屏 session 在变短的 tool 结果滚出屏幕顶部时以错误结束的问题

items.en: Fixed prompt suggestions making extra API requests when the model replied with a tool call
items.zh: 修复 prompt 建议在模型以 tool 调用回复时发出额外 API 请求的问题

items.en: Fixed `PreToolUse` `mcp_tool` hooks on stdio and HTTP MCP servers being skipped when their answer was over 16 MiB; the tool call is now refused
items.zh: 修复 stdio 和 HTTP MCP 服务器上的 `PreToolUse` `mcp_tool` hook 在其应答超过 16 MiB 时被跳过的问题；现在会拒绝该 tool 调用

items.en: Fixed skill and command names holding a Bamum letter that some fonts draw as blank: they are now refused
items.zh: 修复 skill 和命令名称包含某些字体显示为空白字符的巴穆姆字母的问题：现在会拒绝这类名称

items.en: Fixed `claude -p` on Linux exiting 0 in silence when a full NFS export or a used-up NFS quota lost transcript lines: it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1
items.zh: 修复 Linux 上 `claude -p` 在 NFS 导出已满或 NFS 配额耗尽导致 transcript 行丢失时静默以 0 退出的问题：现在会打印错误，并在 text 和 json 输出中以 1 退出

items.en: Fixed background agents being reported as stopped by the user, and refused a resume, when a service interrupted a cloud session and nobody pressed Stop
items.zh: 修复当服务中断云 session 且无人按下 Stop 时，后台 agent 被报告为用户已停止并拒绝恢复的问题

items.en: Fixed NotebookEdit reporting success to hooks and telemetry when the edit failed, for example when the notebook changed while the permission prompt was open
items.zh: 修复 NotebookEdit 在编辑失败时（例如权限提示打开期间 notebook 发生变化）仍向 hook 和遥测报告成功的问题

items.en: Fixed a blank screen or no answer at startup, and empty `claude mcp list` output, when a stored MCP sign-in record was null
items.zh: 修复存储的 MCP 登录记录为 null 时启动出现空白屏幕或无应答，以及 `claude mcp list` 输出为空的问题

items.en: Fixed the Artifact tool telling Claude to add filters when an artifact's database collection is too large to sort; it now says to read the collection page by page and sort the results
items.zh: 修复 Artifact tool 在 artifact 的数据库集合过大无法排序时提示 Claude 添加筛选条件的问题；现在会提示逐页读取集合并对结果排序

items.en: Fixed a restarted cloud session dropping a message with a large image when the restart came before Claude's first reply to it
items.zh: 修复重启的云 session 在 Claude 首次回复之前重启时，丢弃包含大图片的消息的问题

items.en: Fixed a restarted cloud session leaving a subagent's message to the main conversation unanswered
items.zh: 修复重启的云 session 导致 subagent 发给主对话的消息无人应答的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running
items.zh: 修复停止或暂停正在运行的 workflow 时 Claude 未被告知的问题，因此不再声称 workflow 仍在运行

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a plugin's permission request showing a name with hidden characters: it now reads "a plugin"
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复 plugin 的权限请求显示包含隐藏字符的名称的问题：现在显示为“a plugin”

summary.tldr: 新增默认 Fable 5.2 模型与多项安全修复，网关与权限行为有变更需注意。

highlights.title: 新增默认 Fable 5.2 模型
highlights.detail: claude-fable-5-2 成为默认 Fable 模型，1M 上下文，$8/$40 每 Mtok，缓存读取 $0.20。

highlights.title: Fable 5.1 选择迁移至 fable
highlights.detail: 已保存的 Fable 5.1 选择会迁移到 fable；Pro/Max 立即生效，Team/Enterprise 需组织允许。
highlights.action: 如需继续使用旧模型，运行 /model claude-fable-5-1 切回。

highlights.title: 网关忽略 ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL
highlights.detail: Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 上游不再读取网关环境中的 ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL 变量。
highlights.action: 如需自定义端点，请在上游设置 base_url。

highlights.title: 修复 MCP OAuth 令牌泄露
highlights.detail: 服务器重定向时，MCP OAuth 请求不再把刷新令牌等机密发送到另一主机。

highlights.title: 修复沙箱与权限绕过
highlights.detail: 只读 Bash 命令不再无提示在沙箱外运行；Bash 权限检查不再从错误文件夹判断写入；cp/mv 写入目录时拒绝规则与保护文件提示现已生效。

highlights.title: mod 工具调用不再触发权限提示
highlights.detail: mod 自身工具调用不再触发权限提示，deny 规则与组织策略仍生效；自动与 bypass 模式下 mod 无需询问即可启用。
